contract.review_scope: Full retained body read, authored input/output/effect/branch/configuration/error/transaction/concurrency explanations; source current per owner.
contract.purpose: Summarize warehouse locations by locating zone and return four location tiles.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE PROCEDURE INV_MonitorLocationChartData @filterCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX), @culture NVARCHAR(10) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: No matching active locations yields NULL SUM totals/empty counts; percentage ELSE is 0. NOT IN is NULL-sensitive. Duplicate warehouse filters assign an unordered value.
output_shape: Five result sets: zone chart (CATEGORY,DATA,DESCRIPTION,axis/title/drilldown metadata), then TOTAL_LOCATIONS, EMPTY_LOCATIONS, PERCENT_EMPTY, FROZEN_EMPTY. Chart ties have no further order.

ordered_branches.explanation: Parse warehouse; group active coded-status locations by locating zone, with localized NULL category and DATA descending.

Calculate total/empty counts by summing distinct-location counts grouped by location and status. Compute percentage and frozen-empty count, then return four separate tiles. The frozen-empty exclusion reads LOCATION_INVENTORY location names across all warehouses.

configuration_scope_and_precedence: Warehouse filter scopes outer queries; culture affects only NULL-category resource. Location/status grouping can count a location more than once if view rows expose differing statuses.
error_and_return_handling: Final @@ERROR/GOTO only observes the latest statement; it is not comprehensive error capture. Normal return 0, NOCOUNT restored OFF.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoint or SET XACT_ABORT in this body. Caller/session transaction behavior governs partial completion; this contract does not assume atomic child calls.
concurrency: Separate chart and tile queries have no shared snapshot; counts can drift between results.
contract.trigger_behavior: No direct persistent DML; called routines retain their own trigger and effect contracts.
